Calculate Batch Integration Metrics

Source: R/04_metrics_batch.R
evaluate_batch_metrics.Rd

Evaluates how realistically simulated technical batches mix or separate, computing the five canonical Category IV (Technical Variation & Batch Mixing Dynamics) metrics: Batch Silhouette, PC Regression R2, CMS (Cell-Specific Mixing Score), Inverse Simpson Index (ISI), and cross-batch cell type classification macro F1.

Usage

evaluate_batch_metrics(
  data,
  batch_info,
  k = NULL,
  n_pcs = 30,
  cell_types = NULL,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

Count or log-normalized expression matrix (features x cells).

batch_info

Factor or character vector of batch assignments for each cell.

k

Neighborhood size k for k-NN graph and mixing metrics. Default is min(table(batch_info))/2.

n_pcs

Number of principal components for embedding evaluation. Default is 30.

cell_types

Optional factor or character vector of cell types for cross-batch evaluation.

verbose

Logical, whether to print progress.

Value

A named list of batch metrics:

batch_silhouette

Average silhouette width using batch labels (lower is better mixed)

pcr_r2

Total variance explained by batch in principal components (PCR)

cms

Mean Cell-specific mixing score (CellMixS)

isi

Mean Inverse Simpson Index for batch mixing (CellMixS)

cross_batch_F1

Mean cross-batch cell type transfer macro F1 (if cell_types supplied)

Examples

data(example_scrna, package = "scSimEval")
evaluate_batch_metrics(example_scrna$ref, example_scrna$batch_info,
                       cell_types = example_scrna$cell_types)
#> $batch_silhouette
#> [1] -0.001626347
#> 
#> $pcr_r2
#> [1] 0.01058094
#> 
#> $cms
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $isi
#> [1] 1.923783
#> 
#> $cross_batch_F1
#> [1] 0.4460483
#>
